valores.label: Days from Paul's Slide closure to the Regent's Slide reopening

fonte: Caltrans District 5, "Highway 1 to Reopen Today at Regent's Slide" (January 14, 2026)
texto_para_tela: PAUL'S SLIDE · JAN 14, 2023 – JUN 23, 2024 | REGENT'S SLIDE · FEB 9, 2024 · 6 MI NORTH | ALMOST THREE YEARS
nota: Caltrans: 'Regent's Slide occurred on February 9, 2024, and overlapped with Paul's Slide, six miles to the south, which closed the highway from January 14, 2023, to June 23, 2024'; '…for the first time in almost three years'. '6 MI NORTH' = o Regent's a seis milhas ao norte do Paul's: vale. A conta das datas dá 3 anos exatos (1.096 dias); 'almost three years' é a forma da própria Caltrans, e a voz a segue.
licenca: fato e citação curta de órgão do Estado da Califórnia, com atribuição (uso editorial), recriados no visual do canal

pedidos.pedido: L5: Paul's Slide 'closed the highway from January 14, 2023, to June 23, 2024' (R168, R172); 'Highway 1 from Carmel to Cambria in Big Sur' (R169); 'Regent's Slide occurred on February 9, 2024' (R170); 'Slide, six miles to the south' (R171); 'open the portion of Highway 1 closed by Regent' (R173); 'uninterrupted access along the Big Sur coast between Carmel and Cambria for the first time in almost three years' (R174). Tela PAUL'S SLIDE · JAN 14, 2023 – JUN 23, 2024; REGENT'S SLIDE · FEB 9, 2024 · 6 MI NORTH; ALMOST THREE YEARS.
